title: Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering for Efficient and Controllable LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models improve final-answer accuracy through extended chain-of-thought reasoning, but often spend tokens inefficiently and offer little inference-time control. Existing efficient reasoning methods control thinking length by shortening, early-stopping, or compressing traces, leaving how the model thinks implicit. In this paper, we propose Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering (ACTS), which formulates reasoning steering as a Markov decision process where a controller agent adaptively steers a frozen reasoner during inference. At each step, the controller observes the reasoning trace and remaining thinking budget, then issues a steering action consisting of a reasoning strategy and a steering phrase that initiates the next reasoner step. translated_title: 面向高效且可控大语言模型推理的智能体思维链引导方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通过扩展的思维链推理提升了最终答案的准确率，但往往低效地消耗 token，且在推理阶段几乎缺乏可控性。现有的高效推理方法通过缩短、提前停止或压缩推理轨迹来控制思考长度，使得模型“如何思考”的过程保持隐式。本文提出智能体思维链引导方法（Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering, ACTS），将推理引导形式化为一个马尔可夫决策过程，由一个控制器智能体在推理过程中自适应地引导一个冻结的推理模型。在每一步，控制器观察当前的推理轨迹和剩余的思考预算，然后发出一个引导动作，该动作由一种推理策略和一个用于启动推理模型下一步的引导短语组成。这使得系统能够在保持推理模型生成连续性的同时，实现预算感知的策略控制，从而达成高效推理。我们基于构建的合成（摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）来初始化控制器智能体。
tldr: 本文提出ACTS方法，将推理引导建模为马尔可夫决策过程，由控制器智能体在推理时根据推理轨迹和剩余思考预算，自适应地向冻结的推理模型发出“推理策略+引导短语”的引导动作，从而在保持生成连续性的同时实现预算感知、高效且可控的大语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: ACTS formulates reasoning steering as a Markov decision process in which a controller agent adaptively issues steering actions—combining a reasoning strategy and a steering phrase—to a frozen reasoner during inference, enabling budget-aware, efficient, and controllable LLM reasoning while preserving generation continuity.
